title: Pasta e lenticchie
ingredients: Lentil 20 min boil with pinch of salt, make soffrito equal chunks food processor. Sweat soffrito in oiled pan, add can of tomatoes, add lentils , some water, add garlic one clove (prefer in shirt), add pasta and cook til pasta done (see note for.more details)
